channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: AREA ROUNDUP: No. 1 Knights get ready for Harrells by thrashing Liberty
item.description: Top-ranked Greenfield boys rout Liberty ahead of Harrells clash as Wilson Prep girls earn 13th straight win and Community Christian teams post big MACAA results across varsity and JV action.

item.title: Southern Wayne snatches 31-30 win from Hunt girls
item.description: Southern Wayne edged Hunt 31-30 after a late steal-and-layup by Myhirah Hunt capped a turnover-filled Big East girls matchup, giving the Saints a season sweep and fourth place in the league.

item.title: Fike girls sink to Big East basement after losing to NN
item.description: After 4 years atop 3-A, Fike girls basketball is mired in the 5-A/6-A Big East cellar after a 51-28 loss at Northern Nash, marking the Demons’ fifth straight defeat and dropping them to 1-7 in league play.

item.title: Demons knocked out of Big East perch in OT loss to Knights
item.description: Northern Nash edged Fike 91-84 in overtime Thursday, completing a season sweep, led by freshman Quantay James’ 27 points and knocking the Golden Demons out of a share of first in the 5-A/6-A Big East.

item.title: Warriors overcome lethargy, Saints to reclaim Big East lead
item.description: A 14-0 third-quarter surge lifted No. 8 Hunt past Southern Wayne 67-59, overcoming a sluggish start and, with Fike’s OT loss, putting the Warriors alone atop the Big East boys basketball standings at 7-1.

item.title: Church news: Congregations gather for services
item.description: Wilson-area churches announce Feb. 1 worship times, youth and appreciation services, Bible studies, a Valentine’s event and community meals.

item.title: Prep continues for heavy snow, cold temperatures
item.description: Wilson braces for up to a foot of snow, subzero wind chills and scattered power outage risks as DOT crews ready plows and officials urge limited travel during this rare storm.

item.title: Ron Lievense Court officially dedicated at Wilson Gym
item.description: Barton College has dedicated Ron Lievense Court at Wilson Gym, honoring the retired coach who led the Bulldogs to the 2007 NCAA Division II title and a program-record 518 wins.

item.title: Design meeting details park improvement plans
item.description: N.C. State University seniors unveiled new designs for Freeman and Carolina Street parks, gathering resident feedback on new layouts funded by a Golden Leaf Foundation grant.

item.title: ‘Love the Symphony’ features soloist Elizabeth Winstead
item.description: Barton College/Wilson Symphony’s 34th annual “Love the Symphony” Valentine’s benefit on Feb. 14 features soprano Elizabeth Winstead, wine reception and candlelight buffet; tickets $100 with reservations.
